fixture_taint_summary: 9 F2P: 7 are TestClient-driven HTTP integration tests (test_annotated.test_get + 6 test_tutorial/test_annotated/test_tutorial*.test_get) exercising Annotated[T, Query()] / Annotated[T, Depends()] dependency injection. 2 (test_ambiguous_params) use pytest.raises against public FastAPI route decoration to verify the new restrictions on mixing Annotated metadata with defaults. triage.test_level_policy: All augmented selectors exercise FastAPI through public route decorators and TestClient requests. The F2P selectors validate PEP-593 Annotated metadata carrying FastAPI public parameter metadata classes; the P2P selector uses ordinary non-Annotated query-default request handling to guard adjacent unchanged behavior.

tests/test_annotated_aug.py::test_annota.public_surface: FastAPI route declaration using Annotated[str, fastapi.params.Form()] and TestClient form submission.
tests/test_annotated_aug.py::test_annota.rationale: PEP 593 syntax allows Annotated[T, metadata] to carry runtime metadata while preserving the base type. FastAPI exposes Form as public parameter metadata, and the PR made the Form metadata class usable inside Annotated without requiring a duplicate positional default. The survivor changes that constructor default back to a required argument, so this public route declaration errors before the request can succeed.

tests/test_annotated_aug.py::test_annota.public_surface: FastAPI route declaration using Annotated[bytes, fastapi.params.File()] and TestClient multipart upload.
tests/test_annotated_aug.py::test_annota.rationale: PEP 593 syntax lets FastAPI consume File metadata from Annotated without replacing the annotated type. The PR made the File metadata class mirror the Annotated default behavior used by other parameter metadata classes. The survivor requires an explicit default again, so this multipart route distinguishes the mutant through the public request path.

tests/test_annotated_aug.py::test_plain_.public_surface: FastAPI route declaration with a normal query parameter default and TestClient GET requests.
tests/test_annotated_aug.py::test_plain_.rationale: PEP 593 consumption is additive: FastAPI should consume Annotated metadata without disturbing ordinary non-Annotated parameter defaults. This P2P selector guards the adjacent dependency-resolution behavior that must remain unchanged by the Annotated support patch.
